column3: With respect to the Birch Run Premium Outlets Mortgage Loan (2.6%), the Appraised Value of $158,700,000 is based on the extraordinary assumptions that certain vacant land at the Mortgaged Property that is permitted to be released under the terms of the related Mortgage Loan documents will be subdivided from the main parcel of the Mortgaged Property based on the estimated site area provided to the appraiser and any unsigned leases that are out for signature will be executed. See “—Certain Terms of the Mortgage Loans—Releases; Partial Releases; Property Additions”.
